title: Sonnet 5.5 is no better than GLM 5.3 Flash at iOS work. It just costs 2.6x more.
summary: Daniel Bernal compares Sonnet 5.5 and GLM 5.3 Flash on 148 Apple-platform repair tasks, reporting 145 versus 143 passes and lower list-price cost for GLM at longer execution times. An iOS team can inspect independent build, test, and Simulator graders before choosing a model, while accounting for different harnesses, effort settings, and run dates; weighted scores can change as the suite’s model coverage grows.
takeaway: Compare raw passes, failed end-to-end tasks, list-price telemetry, harness settings, and elapsed time separately; reproduce representative native tasks before adopting the article’s broad cost conclusion.
